summary: Join our specialized training in real estate litigation and dispute resolution. Gain practical knowledge and strategies to excel in legal disputes effectively.
lede: Real estate dispute resolution training helps property managers, asset managers, developers, and in-house counsel manage property conflicts. It covers identifying early risks, documenting issues, comparing negotiation, mediation, arbitration, and litigation, working with lawyers, and developing settlement strategies for lease, tenancy, title, construction, and development disputes.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored to professionals who regularly engage with real estate, property contracts, or related disputes. These individuals play a crucial role in managing and resolving conflicts that arise in the dynamic field of real estate.
audience: Asset and portfolio managers in real estate
modules: Foundations of Real Estate Litigation and Dispute Resolution
Dispute Resolution Options in Real Estate
Working with Lawyers, Courts, and Tribunals
Negotiation and Settlement in Real Estate Conflicts
Regulation, Compliance, and Public Interest Considerations
Risk Management and Dispute Prevention in Real Estate
Communicating, Reporting, and Learning from Disputes
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of real estate operations and some experience in dealing with property-related issues. Familiarity with real estate contracts and dispute scenarios will be beneficial.
